modpacks_description: Sons of the Forest modpacks made by the community. Download one and SotF Mods Manager installs every mod in it.
modpacks_intro: Ready-made sets of mods. Download a modpack and SotF Mods Manager installs all its mods in one go.
modpacks_empty_text: Put your favourite mods together and share them as a modpack.
modpacks_detail_title: {name}, a Sons of the Forest modpack
modpacks_detail_description: {name} by {author}: {count, plural, one {# mod} other {# mods}} for Sons of the Forest. Download it and install everything with SotF Mods Manager.
modpacks_howto: Open the downloaded .sotfprofile file in SotF Mods Manager (Profiles, Import profile) to install every mod.
modpacks_conflicts_title: Some mods in this modpack are not compatible with each other
modpacks_unavailable_count: {count, plural, one {# mod is no longer available and is skipped by the download.} other {# mods are no longer available and are skipped by the download.}}
modpacks_unavailable_notice: No longer available: {names}. They are skipped when the modpack is downloaded.
modpacks_mine_description: Group mods into a modpack that anyone can install with SotF Mods Manager.
modpacks_mine_empty_text: Create one from scratch or import a .sotfprofile exported from SotF Mods Manager.
modpacks_new_description: Pick the mods, put them in order and describe what the modpack is for.
modpacks_pending_hint: A moderator will review this modpack before it appears on the site.

modpacks_cover_wrong_type: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
modpacks_mods_description: Only approved mods can be added. Their dependencies are added automatically.
modpacks_mods_empty: No mods yet. Search below to add some.
modpacks_auto_hint: These mods are needed by others in the modpack.
modpacks_saved_pending: Modpack saved. A moderator will review it before it is published.

modpacks_review_description: Modpacks from members who are not verified creators wait here until a moderator approves them.
